parameters.name: selection_method
parameters.help: Choose a method to select the data to be analyzed.

parameters.name: freeze
parameters.help: Do you want analysis windows to freeze their selected subsets? (If no, analysis windows update for each new selection.)

parameters.name: pan_type
parameters.prompt: Display data by traces or ensembles?
parameters.help: Choose whether to control the trace display by traces or ensembles.

choices.label: Traces
choices.help: Control data display by number of traces.

choices.label: Ensembles
choices.help: Control data display by number of ensembles.

parameters.name: num_traces
parameters.prompt: Number of traces per analysis location
parameters.help: Enter the number of traces to display for each analysis location.

parameters.name: trace_pan_inc
parameters.prompt: Number of traces between analysis locations
parameters.help: Enter the number of traces between successive analyses. For 0, number of traces per location is used.

parameters.name: num_ensembles
parameters.prompt: Number of ensembles per analysis location
parameters.help: Enter the number of ensembles to display for each analysis location.

parameters.name: ens_pan_inc
parameters.prompt: Number of ensembles between analysis locations
parameters.help: Enter the number of ensembles between successive analyses. For 0, number of ensembles per location is used.

parameters.name: prim_key
parameters.prompt: Primary header for sorting and trace label
parameters.help: Select the primary header for the trace annotation. WARNING! The traces will be sorted by this header value for display.

parameters.name: sec_key
parameters.prompt: Secondary header for sorting and trace label
parameters.help: Select a header for the trace annotation. WARNING! The traces will be sorted by this header value for display.

parameters.name: show_ave_power
parameters.help: Do you want to display the average power spectrum initially?

parameters.name: power_type
parameters.prompt: Type of scaling for power spectrum
parameters.help: Do you want to display the power spectrum in decibels or percentage of the reference power?

parameters.name: power_mapping
parameters.prompt: Type of mapping for power spectrum
parameters.help: Do you want to display the frequency axis with linear or log scale?

parameters.name: ref_power
parameters.help: Reference power. (For negative input, reference power is set to the maximum power.)

parameters.name: show_ave_phase
parameters.help: Do you want to display the average phase spectrum initially?

parameters.name: shift_option
parameters.prompt: Time, sample, linear or no phase shift?
parameters.help: Select a linear phase shift, a time shift, or a sample shift to be applied to the phase spectrum.

parameters.name: deg_per_hz
parameters.help: Enter the slope of the linear phase shift applied to the phase spectrum in degrees per Hertz.

parameters.name: time_shift
parameters.help: Enter the time to shift the data in msec.

parameters.name: sample_shift
parameters.help: Enter the number of samples to shift the data (-=up, +=down).

parameters.name: unwrap
parameters.help: Do you want to unwrap the phase spectrum? (Add or subtract multiples of 360 degrees to make phase continuous.)

parameters.name: show_trace_data
parameters.help: Do you want to display the selected trace data initially?

parameters.name: show_fx_power
parameters.help: Do you want to display the  FX power spectrum initially?

parameters.name: show_data_taper
parameters.help: Do you want to display the pre-FFT time window initially?

parameters.name: tap_type
parameters.help: Select your desired method of tapering the pre-FFT time window to reduce FFT 'edge' effects.

parameters.name: pct_flat
parameters.prompt: Percent flat for the pre-FFT time window
parameters.help: Enter the percentage of the pre-FFT time window which is NOT tapered. (100.0 = no taper).

parameters.name: auto_freq_range
parameters.help: By default, displayed frequency ranges are set automatically. Select NO if you want to set the frequency range yourself.

parameters.name: min_freq
parameters.help: Enter the minimum frequency (in Hz) for spectral displays .

parameters.name: max_freq
parameters.help: Enter the maximum frequency (in Hz) for spectral displays .

parameters.name: auto_power_range
parameters.help: By default, displayed power ranges are set automatically. Select NO if you want to set the power range yourself.

parameters.name: min_power
parameters.help: Enter the minimum power on power displays (dB, percentage, or raw power depending on the type of power scaling).

parameters.name: max_power
parameters.help: Enter the maximum power on power displays (dB, percentage, or raw power depending on the type of power scaling).

parameters.name: auto_phase_range
parameters.help: By default, displayed phase ranges are set automatically. Select NO if you want to set the phase range yourself.

parameters.name: min_phase
parameters.help: Enter the minimum phase (in degrees) on phase displays .

parameters.name: max_phase
parameters.help: Enter the maximum phase (in degrees) on phase displays .

parameters.name: DEBUG
parameters.help: To debug program, enter YES.  You will have to debug the program yourself.
